text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Monday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Algeria experienced its first pluralist debate on economic questions at start of a five-day national conference over development.
- Foreign Minister Ahmed Attaf urges U.N. Security Council to take on its responsibility over violence between Israel and Palestinians.
- Political parties say debate on the economy is positive but came late.
- Hunger strike to spread among Air Algerie's pilots.
